svg.title: Interpretation scope of numerical learning evidence
svg.desc: Gradient, curvature, frozen testing and conditional bootstrap answer different questions and do not alone guarantee future shifted-population performance.

g.text: Curvature and scale: optimisation stability explanation
Frozen test: risk estimate for the declared mixture
Stratified intervals: approximate uncertainty, fixed counts/model
